reason: S1 adds extensive WUFFS_BASE__PIXEL_FORMAT__YA_NONPREMUL handling, but H0 never selects that format because it is absent from pixfmts. Consequently, neither YA_NONPREMUL source/destination swizzle configurations nor the newly accepted YA_NONPREMUL destination for swizzle_ycck are exercised. H0 also never directly invokes the changed pixel-buffer color getter/setter APIs.
evidence: H0's pixfmts array contains Y, Y_16BE, indexed, BGR, BGRA, RGB, and RGBA formats but not WUFFS_BASE__PIXEL_FORMAT__YA_NONPREMUL.

fuzz_swizzle_interleaved_from_slice derives both dst_pixfmt and src_pixfmt exclusively from pixfmts, so wuffs_private_impl__pixel_swizzler__prepare__ya_nonpremul and its YA-specific SRC/SRC_OVER conversion functions cannot be selected.

fuzz_swizzle_ycck also derives dst_pixfmt exclusively from pixfmts, while S1 specifically adds WUFFS_BASE__PIXEL_FORMAT__YA_NONPREMUL to wuffs_base__pixel_swizzler__swizzle_ycck's accepted destination-format switch.

S1 adds YA_NONPREMUL cases to wuffs_base__pixel_buffer__color_u32_at and wuffs_base__pixel_buffer__set_color_u32_at, including the new wuffs_base__color_u32_argb_premul__as__color_u16_alpha_gray_nonpremul conversion; H0 contains no direct calls to either pixel-buffer API.
recommended_action: Add WUFFS_BASE__PIXEL_FORMAT__YA_NONPREMUL to H0's format selection so it is fuzzed as both source and destination with WUFFS_BASE__PIXEL_BLEND__SRC and SRC_OVER, and as the destination of fuzz_swizzle_ycck; also add focused fuzzing of color_u32_at/set_color_u32_at for YA_NONPREMUL pixels, coordinates, alpha values, and guarded buffer boundaries.
